spatial_policy.exception_justification: Historical QuebecTrees train/validation tiles share ground footprint (source_scan/spatial_summary.json). EXP-028 is an exploratory within-benchmark comparison of two arms on the same split; no spatial-independence claim.

spatial_waiver.justification: Same historical split as every QuebecTrees result in this project; both arms share it, so the comparison is matched.
spatial_waiver.approver: project owner (chat approval of a06 onboarding for EXP-028, 2026-11-20)
spatial_waiver.effect_on_claims: exploratory only; validation is not spatially independent of train

sampling.note: min_valid 0.3 = CanopyCropDataset default used by M0; queries/max_targets apply to Q only

comparison.postprocessing: evaluation only: EXP-016 saddle merge tau 0.3 + EXP-025 SDT gate (canopy > 0.30, SDT > -0.9)
comparison.evaluator_version: pycocotools COCOeval segm maxDets 400 + a06 metrics 2.0.0

runtime.determinism_note: seeded but not bitwise deterministic (CUDA atomics in interpolate backward), as for historical M0

primary_endpoints: recall@IoU0.5 of validation GT crowns < 2 m2 (COCO area, world-coordinate dedup)
